reason.recommendations: Reshape logits to (B*T,V) before F.kl_div, or use reduction=mean, or weight KD by 1/(T*V). After normalization, sweep KD/CE ratios (0.9/0.1, 0.5/0.5, 0.1/0.9) and tau in {1,2,4} on a short budget before re-committing 10k steps.
reason.interesting_reason: Methodology gotcha for future KD attempts: PyTorch's F.kl_div reduction='batchmean' divides only by the leading dim, not by all elements — so on (B,T,V) it returns the sum over T*V per sample, ~10x larger than token-mean CE. Easy bug for any KD loop on (B,T,V) tensors; will recur unless explicitly normalized.
